scores.comment: Strength: the brief covers the core need. It names the decision (moving budget next quarter) and defines a clear 12-month repeat purchase rate on completed orders only, with monthly cohorts across the last 2 years. It is also honest about limits, flagging that there is no spend data, that monthly cohorts may be small, and that each customer has a single channel on their record. Gap: the audience was guessed as the marketing lead instead of being asked, and the stakeholder actually reports to the CMO. The 12-month window (365 days or 12 calendar months) and how to treat a second order on the same day are also left open, so two analysts could still get slightly different numbers.
